knowledge:
- key_parameters: data=A data.frame containing the protein intensities ;; md=A data.frame containing the meta-data information ;; protein_column=The column in the data frame that contains the protein IDs ;; gene_column=The column in the data frame that contains the gene IDs ;; condition_column=The column in the meta-data table that contains the condition information ;; label_column=The column in the meta-data table that contains sample label information ;; batch_column=The column in the meta-data table that contains the batch information (for TMT data) ;; ref_samples=The samples that should be used as reference samples for normalization (for TMT data) ;; ain=Specifies which assays (normalization methods) to use, plot, or evaluate (setting to NULL uses all available assays) ;; thr=Threshold value between 0 and 1 for filtering proteins with too many missing values ;; diff=Logical value indicating whether to plot absolute variation (FALSE) or the reduction of variation compared to log2 (TRUE)
- alternatives: POMA package (via detect_outliers_POMA) is used for automated outlier detection based on group centroids and distances ;; limma::removeBatchEffects (via limBE in PRONE) or Internal Reference Scaling (IRS) are used for batch effect correction in TMT datasets
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing high-throughput proteomics datasets (TMT or LFQ) that require systematic bias adjustment, comparative evaluation of multiple normalization methods, and preparation for downstream differential expression analysis.
- pitfalls: Sample names must be saved in a column named 'Column' in the metadata table and must match the column names in the protein intensity table ;; Do not prematurely remove reference samples before normalization as they are required for batch correction methods like IRS ;; Imputation can introduce bias and skew sample distributions, so it should be used with caution and evaluated using exploratory plots ;; Do not rely solely on intragroup variation metrics (PCV, PEV, PMAD) to select a normalization method; also consider visual inspection (PCA, boxplots) and downstream differential expression results.

workflows.name: proteomics_normalization_evaluation
workflows.intent: Preprocess, normalize, evaluate, and impute proteomics data (TMT or LFQ) stored in a SummarizedExperiment object.
input: tuberculosis_metadata.csv (CSV containing sample metadata with a 'Column' column matching sample names in the intensity table)
workflows.stages: 1. Load data into a SummarizedExperiment object ;; 2. Filter out low-quality proteins and contaminants ;; 3. Perform sample quality control and outlier detection ;; 4. Apply multiple normalization and batch correction methods ;; 5. Evaluate normalization performance qualitatively and quantitatively ;; 6. Perform missing value imputation ;; 7. Export the normalized and processed datasets
workflows.code:
data_path <- readPRONE_example("tuberculosis_protein_intensities.csv")
md_path <- readPRONE_example("tuberculosis_metadata.csv")
data <- read.csv(data_path)
md <- read.csv(md_path)
md$Column <- stringr::str_replace_all(md$Column, " ", ".")
ref_samples <- md[md$Group == "ref",]$Column
se <- load_data(data, md, protein_column = "Protein.IDs", gene_column = "Gene.names", ref_samples = ref_samples, batch_column = "Pool", condition_column = "Group", label_column = "Label")
se <- subset_SE_by_norm(se, ain = c("raw", "log2"))
get_NA_overview(se, ain = "log2")
plot_condition_overview(se, condition = NULL)
plot_heatmap(se, ain = "log2", color_by = c("Pool", "Group"), label_by = NULL, only_refs = FALSE)
plot_upset(se, color_by = NULL, label_by = NULL, mb.ratio = c(0.7,0.3), only_refs = FALSE)
plot_markers_boxplots(se, markers = c("Q92954;J3KP74;E9PLR3", "Q9Y6Z7"), ain = "log2", id_column = "Protein.IDs", facet_norm = FALSE, facet_marker = TRUE)
se <- filter_out_complete_NA_proteins(se)
se <- filter_out_proteins_by_value(se, "Reverse", "+")
se <- filter_out_proteins_by_value(se, "Only.identified.by.site", "+")
pot_contaminants <- get_proteins_by_value(se, "Potential.contaminant", "+")
se <- filter_out_proteins_by_ID(se, pot_contaminants)
plot_NA_heatmap(se, color_by = NULL, label_by = NULL, cluster_samples = TRUE, cluster_proteins = TRUE)
plot_NA_density(se)
plot_NA_frequency(se)
se <- filter_out_NA_proteins_by_threshold(se, thr = 0.7)
plot_nr_prot_samples(se, color_by = NULL, label_by = NULL)
plot_tot_int_samples(se, color_by = NULL, label_by = NULL)
se <- remove_samples_manually(se, "Label", c("1.HC_Pool1", "1.HC_Pool2"))
se_no_refs <- remove_reference_samples(se)
poma_res <- detect_outliers_POMA(se, ain = "log2")
se <- remove_POMA_outliers(se, poma_res$outliers)
get_normalization_methods()
se_norm <- normalize_se(se, c("RobNorm", "Mean", "Median", "IRS_on_RobNorm", "IRS_on_Mean", "IRS_on_Median"), combination_pattern = "_on_")
se_norm <- medianNorm(se_norm, ain = "log2", aout = "Median")
names(assays(se_norm))
plot_boxplots(se_norm, ain = NULL, color_by = NULL, label_by = NULL, ncol = 3, facet_norm = TRUE)
plot_densities(se_norm, ain = c("IRS_on_RobNorm", "IRS_on_Median"), color_by = NULL, facet_norm = TRUE)
plot_PCA(se_norm, ain = c("IRS_on_RobNorm", "IRS_on_Median"), color_by = "Group", label_by = "No", shape_by = "Pool", facet_norm = FALSE, facet_by = "Group")
plot_intragroup_correlation(se_norm, ain = NULL, condition = NULL, method = "pearson")
plot_intragroup_PCV(se_norm, ain = NULL, condition = NULL, diff = FALSE)
plot_intragroup_PEV(se_norm, ain = NULL, condition = NULL, diff = FALSE)
plot_intragroup_PMAD(se_norm, ain = NULL, condition = NULL, diff = FALSE)
plot_intragroup_PCV(se_norm, ain = NULL, condition = NULL, diff = TRUE)
se_no_MAD <- remove_assays_from_SE(se_norm, assays_to_remove = c("Mean"))
se_subset <- subset_SE_by_norm(se_norm, ain = c("IRS_on_RobNorm", "IRS_on_Median"))
se <- impute_se(se, ain = NULL)
export_data(se, out_dir = "output/", ain = c("log2", "Median", "LoessF"))
